_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for UNH retrospectives (retro/build_unh.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date. A filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day ('filed' keeps the acceptance time, US Eastern; EDGAR gives only the filing date before 2002); every earnings 8-K of 2007-2009 was accepted before the open on its release day. UnitedHealth Group's fiscal year is the calendar year. The builder uses the latest history vintage published by AS_OF (each year from the latest filing that reports it, ten years to the latest one, each per-share figure on the basis of its own filing and restated by 'splits'), the prints published by AS_OF that report a fiscal year after that history (a Q4 print extends the history until the 10-K), the guides for the current fiscal year (each field from the latest guide that states it) and the vintage's annual dividend. EPS is diluted EPS at the company's figure excluding only one-offs where a filing on the same basis prints it (1998, 1999, 2000, 2007 and 2008), GAAP otherwise; the guides are the company's figures where a guide is given with and without announced items (the IRS Section 409A charges in 2007; the 2008 legal settlements, severance and the Nevada sale), GAAP otherwise. Revenue is guided in dollars, read as growth on the last full year; the operating margin is guided in numbers in the Q1 and Q2 2008 outlook schedules (and derived from guided earnings from operations and revenue in the 8-K of 2008-07-02). A print's growth rates and ratios are derived from the raw figures of its release's statement of operations ('raw', $ millions; the builder re-derives and checks them), each against the year-ago quarter in the same release, as reported (charges in); the Q2 2007 print is restated by its 10-Q from 2007-08-06 ('restated'). Rule T's raw figures are in 'rule_t'. No later fact enters through this file.
